data.text: Official admission procedure and statutory guidelines for The VIDYA School, Sector 24, DLF Phase 3, Gurugram (CBSE Affiliation No. 531105). Admissions prioritize students from underprivileged communities for quality, subsidized English-medium education under Haryana Education Department regulations.

data.message: Current Academic Session 2026–27 classes are active (casual transfer admissions subject to seat availability). content: Fill online application or collect paper form from school reception desk
